item.title: Drop tests with ANSYS/LS-DYNA
item.description:
Drop tests with ANSYS/LS-DYNA Colleagues from the British-Irish CADFEM collected a small presentation on the drop tests simulation in ANSYS with usage of LS-DYNA solver

From the marketing point everything is not even bad, but when I look at the quality of their FE models, corner of my eye starts to twitch.

In general, I now say the terrible idea for LS-DYNA evangelist. ANSYS Explicit STR product could be a better tool for simplest tasks of drop tests (as for example described in the present), :

  • ANSYS Explicit STR already goes under the license of ANSYS Mechanical Enterprise
  • can immediately run on 4 CPU cores
  • works with ANSYS HPC (Pack / Workgroup) licenses for parallelization
  • does not require long training of specialists

So that, ANSYS Explicit STR will be enough in case of simple drop test cases.

You could find original slides here: http://www.cadfemukandireland.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/0930-Ian-turner-Drop-Test.pdf #ANSYS #ANSYS Explicit STR #drop test #explicit #LS-DYNA https://wp.me/p9vWYY-1DA
